title: universal-plugin extension namespace
description: universal-plugin build configuration: the build-target list, per-harness manifest overrides, the plugins depended on, the npm package tracked, and the canonical component input paths the build derives per harness. This is the body of extensions["org.cyberuni.universal-plugin"] in an Agent Plugins Specification v1.0.0 manifest, and nothing else — apply it to the namespace object, not to the manifest.
$comment: The manifest envelope around this object belongs to the Agent Plugins Specification and is validated by https://agent-plugins.org/schemas/1.0.0/plugin.schema.json. That specification assigns no semantics to a namespace object's contents (§8), so this schema supplies them for the one namespace universal-plugin owns. It carries no $id: the fields it describes version with the universal-plugin package that ships it.

vendors.description: Vendor targets to generate manifests for during 'plugin build'.

harnesses.description: Per-harness fields copied verbatim into that harness's derived manifest during 'plugin build'. Keyed by vendor id.

dependencies.description: Plugins this plugin needs. Delivered to the harnesses that read a dependency and dropped with a build warning for the rest — only Claude Code reads one (ADR-0013).

packagePath.description: Relative path (from repo root) to the npm package folder whose version this plugin tracks.

skills.description: Skill directories. Default: ./skills/. Each subdirectory must contain SKILL.md.

mcpServers.description: MCP server configuration. Path string, path config, or inline mcpServers object. Default: ./mcp.json.

hooks.description: Hook configuration. Path string, path config, or inline hooks object. Default: ./hooks/hooks.json. Event names must be PascalCase canonical names — the build translates per vendor.

lspServers.description: LSP server configuration. Path string, path config, or inline server map. Default: ./.lsp.json.

dependencies.description: Each entry names a plugin, optionally qualified with @marketplace. Use the object form to carry a constraint: a range in the string form parses and is then discarded by the runtime.

oneOf.description: Claude Code parses this form loosely, so an unknown key is carried rather than rejected.

version.description: Semver range, checked against the installed plugin's version.

sha.description: Commit sha to pin a git-sourced dependency to.

pathValue.description: A component path: a single path string, an array of path strings, or a path config object with a 'paths' array. All paths must start with './'.

mcpServerMap.description: Map of server name to server configuration.

mcpServersValue.description: MCP server config: a path string, path config, or an inline object with a top-level 'mcpServers' map.

canonicalHookEvent.description: Canonical PascalCase hook event name. The build translates to vendor-specific casing.

prompt.description: Prompt text. Use $ARGUMENTS for event context.

hookAction.description: A single hook action. Discriminated by 'type'.

matcher.description: Optional regex matched against event-specific context (e.g. tool name for PreToolUse).

hooksMap.description: Map of canonical PascalCase event name to an array of hook rules.

hooksValue.description: Hooks config: a path string, path config, or an inline object with a top-level 'hooks' map.

extensionToLanguage.description: Maps file extensions (e.g. '.ts') to language IDs (e.g. 'typescript').

lspServersValue.description: LSP server config: a path string, path config, or an inline map of server name to server config.

oneOf.description: Inline server map. Each key is a server name.

title.description: Label shown in the configuration dialog.

description.description: Help text shown below the input.

default.description: Default value. Type must match the 'type' field.

multiple.description: Array of strings. Only valid when type is 'string'.

sensitive.description: Store securely (e.g. keychain). Only valid when type is 'string'.

min.description: Minimum value. Only valid when type is 'number'.

max.description: Maximum value. Only valid when type is 'number'.

server.description: MCP server name as declared in mcpServers.

harnesses.description: Per-harness manifest overrides, keyed by vendor id. Each block is copied verbatim into that harness's derived manifest.

harnessExtensionClaudeCode.description: Per-harness overrides merged into the derived .claude-plugin/plugin.json (was vendorExtensions['claude-code']).

dependencies.description: Inter-plugin dependencies by name or name+version range.

userConfig.description: Prompted at plugin enable time. Keys are config item names.

hooks.description: Claude Code-only hook events (e.g. PostToolBatch, UserPromptExpansion). Merged with translated canonical hooks.

harnessExtensionClaudeCode.$comment: Open by design. The build copies this block verbatim into the derived manifest and holds no opinion on a field it does not translate, so a vendor field newer than this schema must ride along rather than be rejected. The properties below are the ones documented here, not the ones permitted.

harnessExtensionCursor.description: Per-harness overrides merged into the derived .cursor-plugin/plugin.json (was vendorExtensions['cursor']).

logo.description: Relative path or absolute URL to logo image.

vendorOnlyHooksMap.description: Vendor-specific hook events not in the canonical event set. Keys are vendor-native event names (any string).
